sampling.duration_definition: run updated_at minus created_at (includes queueing and finalization); jobs use completed_at minus started_at. First/last attempt semantics are not a per-test flake measure.
limitations: Bounded recent completed-main sample, not a random or repository-lifetime sample.
In-progress and branch-only experiments are not part of these completed-main statistics.
Runner durations are unweighted elapsed job minutes, not CPU consumption or billed minutes.
Skipped jobs have null duration; GitHub sometimes returns their completion timestamp before start.
Four detailed runs were chosen to explain a success, late export failure, preflight failure and historical Windows dependency failure.
No before/after hosted speedup is claimed by this baseline.
